prospectos.oportunidad: Launch marketing for a new residential housing project

prospectos.porQueAhora: A housing project under construction needs to sell units during construction, not after — every month without professional launch marketing delays sales velocity.
prospectos.servicioSugerido: Real-estate marketing package: property video + photography + Reels + Meta Ads
prospectos.anguloVenta: DAK can own the full launch funnel for the development: renders-to-Reels content, unit-focused Meta Ads and WhatsApp lead routing — a recurring engagement across the entire sales cycle, not a one-off shoot.
prospectos.evidencia: Source: buying-signal public announcement | Verified: project listed 'en construcción' on BCP projects portal 2026. Developer identity, sales team and current ad activity UNVERIFIED.

prospectos.senalCompra: Delcrosa publicly announced the opening of a new Chiclayo branch in 2026 — active northern-market expansion needing immediate local awareness and demand.
prospectos.porQueAhora: A branch opening is a time-bound launch moment: Delcrosa needs local awareness and a reliable pipeline of industrial buyers quickly enough to justify its northern expansion.
prospectos.servicioSugerido: 90-day branch-launch lead-generation package: localized landing page, branch photo/video/Reels, Meta/Google campaigns for northern industrial buyers, WhatsApp/CRM lead routing
prospectos.anguloVenta: Position DAK as the local execution partner for Chiclayo-specific branch content and launch campaigns connected to the commercial team — complementing, not replacing, corporate marketing.
prospectos.evidencia: Source: buying-signal public announcement | Verified: Delcrosa published branch-opening announcement on its own website. Local contacts UNVERIFIED.

prospectos.anguloVenta: Lead with their own growth narrative: DAK can turn the new-location momentum into measurable foot traffic and quote requests via short-form video and geo-targeted campaigns.
prospectos.evidencia: Source: buying-signal public announcement | Verified: company blog post about new Chiclayo location. Local social presence UNVERIFIED.

prospectos.anguloVenta: Reference the June 2026 plant startup directly: DAK can document and promote the Chiclayo operation with professional video and photography while the launch is still news.

AGENT ANALYSIS: A 24-hour multispecialty clinic with maternity packages and preventive-care services has meaningful recurring patient-acquisition potential and likely capacity for a professional agency engagement. Its existing website and WhatsApp appointment flow indicate some digital maturity, while patient education, specialty visibility and conversion follow-up remain plausible areas for improvement; these needs have not been directly confirmed.
